articles.summary: The city is experiencing a resurgence of life and mystique, with many ancient sites still functioning today.
articles.content: Luxor, Egypt's ancient capital during the New Kingdom era, is experiencing a resurgence of life and mystique. The city's west bank, where the Nile River exudes an otherworldly energy, is home to numerous sites that embody this enigmatic atmosphere. One such location is the Mortuary Temple of Seti I, where a sacred sunken lake has been a source of fascination for locals and visitors alike. According to local guide Ahmed Hassan, women from nearby villages still visit the lake, hoping its waters will bring fertility or healing properties to their children. What's remarkable about this site is that despite being a remnant of ancient Egyptian civilization, over 3,000 years old, it remains a functioning source of water, no one knows where it originates. Hassan, born and raised in Luxor, attributes the lake's miraculous properties to its mystique. The area is replete with unexplained phenomena, from the precision of hieroglyphs in ancient tombs to the sheer scale of colossal statues carved from single pieces of granite. One such monument is the colossus of Ramses II, lying prostrate at his funerary temple, the Ramesseum. Measuring approximately 65 feet tall and weighing around 1,000 tons, its construction is a testament to ancient Egypt's engineering prowess. Luxor's history as Egypt's capital during the New Kingdom era, spanning from circa 1550 BCE to 1070 BCE, has left an indelible mark on the city. The west bank, with its sugarcane and banana plantations, limestone canyons, and natural peaks like Al-Qurn (The Horn), continues to captivate visitors with its unique blend of ancient mystery and natural beauty. The Valley of the Kings is one of Luxor's most impressive archaeological sites, featuring intricately decorated tombs that have captivated visitors for centuries. Mennat-Allah El Dorry, an Egyptologist from the American University in Cairo, points out that what sets Luxor apart from other ancient sites is its sheer scale and monumentality. "You have Karnak and Luxor temples on the east bank, and the mortuary temples on the west," she explains. A visit to Luxor's Mortuary Temple of Seti I offers a glimpse into the city's rich history. While not as well-restored as some other sites, this temple provides a sense of tranquility that is hard to find in more popular tourist areas. Nearby, the Valley of the Kings is home to many of Luxor's most famous tombs, including that of Tutankhamen. The air is thick with anticipation as visitors make their way through the narrow corridors and chambers, eager to catch a glimpse of the diminutive mummy lying 26 feet below ground. By contrast, some of the other tombs in the Valley of the Kings are relatively deserted, such as that of Ramses V and VI. This adds to the sense of intimacy and exclusivity that is so characteristic of Luxor's more off-the-beaten-path attractions. As the sun sets over Luxor, the city takes on a timeless quality, with felucca boats gliding effortlessly across the Nile's surface. The clip-clop of horse-drawn carriages provides a soothing background noise, while the call to prayer rises from the minarets above. Meanwhile, on board the Arax, a luxury boat owned by Kazazian Cruises, a different kind of experience is unfolding. This sleek vessel combines traditional Egyptian design with modern amenities, offering guests a unique perspective on Luxor's stunning natural beauty. The nine luxurious cabins of this Nile River vessel are designed to provide guests with an unparalleled experience. Each cabin features premium-quality Egyptian cotton-clad beds that face expansive panoramic picture windows, allowing passengers to take in the breathtaking views of Luxor's natural beauty. To further enhance the comfort and convenience of its guests, the vessel boasts a range of high-end amenities. These include Hermès toiletries, a dedicated massage therapist, and a team of four skilled chefs who are on hand to prepare meals on demand, ensuring that every need is catered for. The founder's vision for this unique travel experience was to combine traditional Egyptian design with modern luxuries. By doing so, they aimed to create an unforgettable journey along the Nile River that would offer guests a level of comfort and seclusion not previously available in the region. In contrast to more understated establishments such as the Marsam Hotel and Habu Hotel, which exude restraint and subtlety, Hotel Al Moudira takes a decidedly different approach. Founded by Italian-Lebanese artist Zeina Aboukheir in 2001, this hotel revels in its maximalism. The hotel's design is a whimsical interplay of domes and arches adorned with terra-cotta plaster, frescoes, and antiques. In 2022, Aboukheir sold the hotel to its new owner, Florian Amereller, but she still plays an active role in guiding the hotel's creative direction. I had the opportunity to stay in one of the five rooms within the salmon pink Villa Casbah, where hand-painted silhouettes of gazelles dance across the walls. Under its new ownership, Al Moudira has expanded significantly, incorporating a large tract of surrounding farmland into its grounds. The restaurant at Al Moudira is a showcase for local artisans who supply products made on-site, from ceramics to textiles. The earthy tones of the crockery are a result of skilled potters working in-house, and guests can even join classes to learn their craft. Meanwhile, artisans elsewhere on the property are busy weaving, carving alabaster, blowing glass, and upholstering furniture. As you step onto Al Moudira's new Nile Canopus, you're immediately struck by the nostalgic charm of this historic waterway. The 180-foot dahabeah is a loving nod to the golden age of travel, with its open-air decks and safari-tent-style coverings designed to evoke the era of Amelia Edwards' classic travelogue A Thousand Miles Up the Nile. The rise of new dahabeahs on the Nile has brought with it a more intimate and personalized experience. Gone are the days of hulking motorboats carrying dozens of passengers; these sleek vessels offer a chance to slow down and appreciate the scenery. While they may not be as sprightly as their sailing ancestors, modern dahabeahs are well-equipped with all the comforts you'd expect. Inside, these luxurious floating hotels are increasingly elaborate. Karine Hassoun's Nile Divine is a celebration of contemporary Egyptian craft, featuring artwork and furnishings by local painters, professors, and artisans. The Oro is another standout, its dark wood exterior paying homage to the classic dahabeahs while boasting a dramatic brass wall in reception and a full-fledged bar on top. Waldorf Astoria Hotels and Resorts are set to join the fray with their new 29-suite Nile cruiser, which promises to bring all the elements of their land-based hotels to the water. This includes its signature Peacock Alley brasserie, offering fine dining in an elegant setting. Meanwhile, Oberoi Hotels and Resorts will launch two seven-suite dahabeahs later this year, featuring interiors by renowned designer Karim Mekhtigian. The Nile Canopus is not alone in its nostalgic charm; many of the new dahabeahs are designed to evoke a bygone era. From their stylish furnishings to their elegant dining areas, these vessels are a far cry from the rough-and-tumble sailing ships that once dominated the waterway. Instead, they offer a chance to relax and unwind in style. As you cruise along the Nile, you can't help but feel that ancient Egypt is indeed newly alive. The proliferation of new dahabeahs has brought with it a renewed sense of excitement and possibility, as travelers seek out more intimate and personalized experiences. Whether you're looking for luxury or adventure, there's never been a better time to explore this iconic waterway. Construction equipment is a common sight along the east bank of Luxor, where a new hotel project is rapidly taking shape. The Four Seasons Hotel, due to open its doors in 2027, is one of several developments transforming the city's landscape. On the other side of town, a beloved landmark is undergoing a major renovation. The Winter Palace, once the base of operations for archaeologist Howard Carter during his excavation of Tutankhamen's tomb in 1922, has closed its doors to undergo a revamp. When it reopens as a Mandarin Oriental property next year, it will mark exactly 120 years since its official inauguration. The timing of this renovation is particularly noteworthy, given the spectacular celestial event that will take place just weeks later. On August 2, Luxor will witness a rare total solar eclipse, with the moon blocking out the sun for a maximum duration of 6 minutes and 22 seconds. This phenomenon has long fascinated visitors to Luxor, where the boundaries between reality and mysticism are often blurred. As the city prepares for this once-in-a-lifetime event, the sense of enchantment in the air is palpable. For travelers looking to stay in a property with its own rich history, there's no shortage of options in Luxor. One standout choice is the Habu Hotel, located just a short distance from the eponymous temple and its stunning hieroglyphs. This 17-room hotel has undergone a stylish revamp, with public areas filled with antique treasures from the 1800s. Guests can relax on the rooftop terrace, taking in the views of the temple's exterior engravings while enjoying a sundowner cocktail. After a day spent exploring Luxor's many sites, there's no better way to unwind than at the Hilton Luxor Resort and Spa. Treatment rooms offer breathtaking views of the Nile River, while the infinity pool is one of the best spots in town to watch the sunset over the city. As you float on a felucca across the Nile River, a private breakfast offers a unique perspective on this ancient waterway. The experience is even more breathtaking when timed to coincide with hot-air balloons soaring majestically over the Valley of the Kings. One hotel that embodies the essence of Luxor's rich history and culture is Hotel Al Moudira, located on the Nile's West Bank. Founded in 2001 by Italian-Lebanese artist Zeina Aboukheir, this Relais and Chateaux property boasts an impressive collection of hand-painted frescoes, antiques, artworks, and furniture sourced from across Egypt. Under new ownership since 2022, Hotel Al Moudira has become even more accessible to visitors, offering easy access to the West Bank's numerous sites. The hotel's grounds are a tranquil oasis, with cool bougainvillea and palm trees providing a serene atmosphere. Six newly added villas offer guests an enhanced level of seclusion while maintaining the property's unique aesthetic. For those seeking a more rustic and immersive experience, Marsam Hotel is an excellent choice. Originally built as the excavation house for the University of Chicago in 1939, this historic hotel has been converted into a charming retreat that eschews modern amenities like swimming pools and TVs. The 29 pared-back rooms and five suites are designed to encourage guests to explore the surrounding sites and immerse themselves in Egypt's rich history. A visit to Marsam Hotel is not complete without enjoying lunch at its farm-to-table restaurant, where the menu changes daily and the sounds of resident donkeys, camels, and horses provide a soothing background melody. articles.title: HSPA+ connectivity displayed on Samsung Galaxy phones
articles.summary: Users of Samsung Galaxy phones may notice the H+ sign at the top of their screen, indicating connectivity to the HSPA+ network, which offers faster data speeds than its predecessor but is slower than modern networks like 5G and 4G.
articles.content: When using a Samsung Galaxy phone, users often notice various symbols displayed at the top of their screen, including the shield icon and the triangle symbol for Data Saver mode. One such symbol that may be less familiar is the H+ sign, which indicates connectivity to the HSPA+ network. The HSPA+ network is an evolved technology that offers faster data speeds compared to its predecessor, HSPA. It stands for High-Speed Packet Access Plus, and it allows for data transfers at a rate of up to 21 Mbps. This is significantly slower than the speeds offered by modern networks like 5G and even 4G. Users may be puzzled as to why their Samsung phones are connecting to the HSPA+ network, especially if they have access to faster options. However, there could be various reasons for this, including location or network availability. It is worth noting that users connected to these networks can still enjoy data speeds ranging from 3.5 Mbps up to 14 Mbps. The actual speed experienced by users will vary depending on their location and the quality of the network connection. For some individuals living in rural areas, the available speeds may be lower, potentially as slow as 1.5 Mbps. This is because HSPA+ networks can have varying levels of performance based on factors like infrastructure and signal strength. The presence of the H+ symbol on Samsung phones highlights the importance of understanding mobile network technologies and their limitations. As these networks continue to evolve, it's essential for users to stay informed about what they're experiencing in terms of speed and reliability. When using a Samsung phone in areas where LTE coverage is limited or non-existent, it's not uncommon for users to connect to an HSPA+ network instead. This is because some regions and mobile carrier networks have yet to fully transition from older 3G cellular technology. In these cases, carriers have implemented HSPA+ as a stopgap measure to provide faster data rates until they can upgrade their networks to LTE. By doing so, they can continue to offer support for heavy data needs without having to invest in complete network overhauls immediately. The key difference between HSPA and HSPA+ lies in their ability to deliver faster connectivity and response times. While HSPA works similarly, its enhanced counterpart offers improved speeds that allow users to stay connected even in areas with limited LTE coverage. HSPA+ is essentially a cost-effective way for carriers to upgrade their networks temporarily, ensuring that customers continue to receive reliable service until they can make the switch to LTE. This approach provides a bridge between older 3G technology and the newer 4G/LTE standard. Users may notice that their Samsung phone defaults to an HSPA+ network if it's located in rural or remote areas without LTE coverage. However, this is less likely for those using more recent Galaxy models that support Voice over LTE (VoLTE), which enables voice calls over the 4G/LTE network. In general, users can expect faster data rates when connected to an HSPA+ network compared to traditional LTE speeds, although these networks are not as fast as LTE Advanced. The specific speeds offered by HSPA+ will vary depending on the carrier and location. Carriers are planning to phase out their 3G/HSPA networks in the coming years. Bell Mobility in Canada has announced that they will completely shut down their 3G network by March 1, 2027. This means that Samsung Galaxy phone users will eventually see a decrease in the appearance of H+ and H symbols in their Android status bars. As carriers upgrade their legacy towers to support 4G or 5G and LTE technology, these phones will seamlessly connect to newer networks, rendering the H+ and H symbols obsolete. articles.title: NFL Players Opt for Extra Protection with Guardian Caps
articles.summary: A growing number of National Football League (NFL) players are opting for extra protection on the field by wearing soft helmet covers known as Guardian Caps during games.
articles.content: A growing number of National Football League (NFL) players are opting for extra protection on the field, donning soft helmet covers known as Guardian Caps during games. Arizona Cardinals left tackle Jayden Williams is among those who have tried this new approach. Williams' decision to wear a Guardian Cap was straightforward: he wanted to minimize his exposure to potential head injuries. As an NFL player, he faces repeated high-impact collisions on the field, and any additional protection seemed like a worthwhile precaution. The number of players choosing to wear Guardian Caps is still relatively small, with around 20 to 25 having done so during this season's games. However, their decision reflects a desire for increased safety in an inherently high-risk sport. Concerns are being raised by Chris Nowinski, CEO of the Concussion & CTE Foundation in Boston, who believes that the NFL may be overstating the benefits of Guardian Caps to provide players with a false sense of security. The NFL's endorsement of Guardian Caps has sparked controversy among experts who question the benefits of these helmets in reducing concussions and CTE rates. Concerns have been raised about the company's claims regarding the effectiveness of Guardian Caps in laboratory settings. According to some, these findings may be overstated or exaggerated, leading players to believe they are receiving added protection that does not actually exist. The NFL's push for Guardian Caps coincides with growing concerns over CTE, a degenerative brain disease linked to repeated head trauma and concussions. This condition has been diagnosed in numerous former NFL players, including Hall of Famers Junior Seau and Ken Stabler, as well as Aaron Hernandez. Laboratory testing reportedly shows that wearing a Guardian Cap can reduce the forces transmitted through the helmet by 10% to 15% if one player is wearing it, and up to 20% to 30% if both players are donning the cap. The use of Guardian Caps in the NFL has been a topic of interest among players and medical professionals alike. The league mandated the caps at contact practices for most players since 2022, but exempted quarterbacks, kickers, and punters from wearing them during such sessions. According to Dr. Allen Sills, the NFL's chief medical officer, the Guardian Cap is not a solution to reducing concussions, but rather a tool to mitigate the impact of head injuries. He emphasized that the cap was introduced as a means to reduce force by even 10-15%, which could be beneficial for players suffering from repetitive head impacts. Sills' comments suggest that the NFL's initial intentions behind introducing the Guardian Cap were not entirely focused on reducing concussions, but rather on finding ways to minimize the effects of repeated blows to the head. The cap is seen as a means to reduce the forces transmitted through helmets during practices and games. Further research published in August 2025 in the American Journal of Sports Medicine found that required use of the Guardian Cap was associated with a significant reduction in the overall incidence of NFL practice concussions, ranging from 54% to 62%. However, it is noted that this reduction may not be solely attributed to the energy-absorbing effects of the cap. The increasing number of NFL players opting to wear Guardian Caps during games has raised eyebrows, but it's not just about aesthetics. The benefits of wearing these caps are still up for debate, and while some players are enthusiastic about their potential impact on injury prevention. Pittsburgh Steelers rookie wide receiver Germie Bernard is one such player who has decided to give the cap a try. When asked about his decision, he revealed that it was largely influenced by those closest to him. "Just talking with family, talk to my girlfriend, too, and it was like, 'Why not?' It can only help you," he said. Bernard's willingness to wear the cap is not unique, as many players in their early stages of careers are choosing to don the Guardian Cap. This trend may be attributed in part to the fact that these young athletes have already become accustomed to wearing such a cap during college or high school, making the transition to the NFL relatively seamless. The distinct appearance of the Guardian Cap has been likened to a "beehive" by some players, including star defensive lineman JJ Watt, who made this comparison back in 2022. The stigma surrounding the Guardian Cap has begun to fade among younger NFL players. Those who wear the cap are more concerned with its functionality than its appearance, as evidenced by Bernard's nonchalant attitude towards it. High-profile players such as Chris Olave and Romeo Doubs have also adopted the Guardian Cap during games. Doubs' endorsement of the product extends beyond his on-field usage, as he hopes to see the cap become a standard piece of equipment for youth football players in the future. The Guardian Cap is not exclusive to professional leagues, with college programs, high school teams, and even younger players incorporating it into their gear. The Guardian Cap has been touted as a safety innovation for football players, but its effectiveness is still uncertain. According to Guardian Sports, their product cannot eliminate the risk of concussions or other head injuries, despite claims suggesting otherwise. Researchers have not established a clear link between impact attenuation tests and actual concussion risks, leaving questions about the cap's true benefits. This ambiguity has raised concerns among experts, who warn against creating a false sense of security among athletes and parents. The uncertainty surrounding the Guardian Cap highlights ongoing debates over the long-term effects of repeated head trauma in football. Some fear that emphasizing safety innovations like this cap may distract from more pressing issues, such as the prevalence of chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE). articles.title: US midterm elections control of Congress hangs in balance
articles.summary: The outcome of eight critical Senate races will determine which party controls the chamber after the election.
articles.content: The 2024 US midterm elections have sparked intense debate over control of Congress, with Republicans fighting to hold onto slim majorities in both chambers as Democrats aim to seize power for the final two years of Donald Trump's term. Public polling indicates a significant advantage for Democrats in key Senate contests and the House, suggesting that NBC News may be able to project control of both chambers on election night. However, the complexity of vote counting and close races will likely prolong the process of determining winners. The Decision Desk at NBC News will closely monitor the outcome of eight critical Senate races, classified as toss-ups or lean Democratic, including contests in Alaska, Iowa, Kansas, Ohio, Texas, Maine, Michigan, and New Hampshire. These states vary significantly in their vote-counting efficiency, with some quick to tally ballots and others notoriously slow. To reclaim Senate control, Democrats would need to win five out of these eight crucial contests, assuming they secure all "Likely" Democratic seats currently projected for them. Flipping North Carolina's Senate seat from red to blue and retaining Georgia in their column would be essential components of this strategy. The outcome of these closely contested races will ultimately determine when NBC News can project control of the Senate. While some states may declare winners early, others may require a more prolonged count, complicating the decision-making process for the Decision Desk. The fate of Congress hangs in the balance as voters head to the polls, and the wait for definitive results is likely to be long and arduous. As vote counting commences, NBC News will closely track developments, providing updates on the status of these pivotal Senate contests. In closely contested Senate races, the margin between winning and losing can be razor-thin, making it challenging to declare a winner on election night. As vote counting commences, the timing of when we will know control of the Senate is uncertain, with some contests potentially taking until early morning hours to resolve. If individual Senate races are as close as predicted, determining overall Senate control may not be possible even if one party appears likely to win. In such scenarios, Americans might wake up on Wednesday without a clear majority decided, despite having a good sense of who will ultimately prevail. The outcome in Alaska is another factor that could prolong the uncertainty, due to its ranked choice voting system which can take several weeks to determine a winner. Past elections provide valuable insights into how quickly votes are counted in each state, even if the exact timing on election night may vary. Looking at historical patterns, some states stand out as fast counters and slow-but-steady counters, with Alaska being a wild card due to its unique voting system. Elections in Michigan are administered at the local level, resulting in a decentralized counting process that can drag on until early morning or even midday Wednesday. The margin of victory plays a significant role in determining how quickly Senate and House races are called, as close contests require more time to tabulate votes. Recent polls have suggested that both Senate races in Michigan would be closely contested, with some favoring the Democratic candidates. However, the early vote appears to be trending in favor of Democrats, which could lead to a wider range of timing possibilities for these races. If the nationwide momentum translates to results, New Hampshire might see its Senate race called before midnight ET on election night. In Michigan, Wayne County is a critical source of ballots, and statewide races often cannot be called without its results being tabulated. The likelihood of calls coming before early morning hours depends on how close the two candidates are in each state, a fact that won't become clear until tonight. The ranked choice voting system used in Alaska's Senate race will determine the winner through a complex process called tabulation. This involves eliminating candidates one by one until a majority is reached, with votes being reallocated based on voters' next-preferred choices. Alaska's ranked choice tabulation typically occurs 15 days after Election Day, providing some clarity on the outcome of this critical Senate seat. However, in Maine, which also uses ranked choice voting for its Senate race, there are no official guidelines for when tabulation will occur. Historically, Maine has released ranked choice results 10 days after its primary election. The uncertainty surrounding Maine's ranked choice tabulation is significant because it may not be known until the next day or even several weeks whether one or both of these seats are needed to win a majority in the Senate. This could lead to a prolonged period of uncertainty regarding control of the upper chamber. In contrast, Democrats only need a net gain of three seats to flip control of the House, making them heavy favorites to succeed. However, the size of their potential majority is still up for grabs and will depend on how much voters shift their support towards the Democratic Party. Recent analysis by our Decision Desk suggests that this nationwide shift could be substantial enough to produce a historically large majority for Democrats or conversely small enough to leave either party with a razor-thin majority. The size of the House majority matters significantly in determining control of the chamber. The smaller the final size of the majority, the longer it will take for our Decision Desk to be certain about who will control the House. If current polls are overestimating Democratic support and the House majority is small, historical data from previous elections can provide some insight into timing. While the 2022 and 2024 elections may offer some clues on how long it will take for us to determine House control, this information alone cannot guarantee a precise timeline. The interplay between current polls, voter sentiment, and election outcomes will ultimately dictate when we can confidently project which party will control the House. The NBC News Decision Desk is currently analyzing data from various sources to determine when control of the House will be projected. Several factors are at play in this process, including current polls, voter sentiment, and election outcomes. One key consideration is the size of the majority that each party achieves - if it's a single-digit number of seats, it may take days or weeks for either party to reach 218 seats. The Decision Desk uses a statistical model to estimate the total number of seats won by both parties, relying solely on past and current vote counts without incorporating any polling data. This model is applied throughout the night after Election Day, providing an indication of which party is likely to control the House. Some states, such as Maine and Alaska, use ranked choice voting in their House elections, potentially delaying projections until 10-15 days after Election Day if control hinges on these districts. Current polls suggest that Democrats are poised to win at least 230 seats, according to recent analysis by the Decision Desk. The outcome of key congressional districts will play a crucial role in determining control of the House and Senate come election day. Kentucky's 6th District is being closely watched as an early bellwether for the midterms. The district saw Trump win by a margin of 15 points, but Democrats can still secure a majority without winning this seat. A narrow victory for Republican Ralph Alvarado in Kentucky's 6th would be seen as a positive sign for Democrats, while a comfortable win would suggest they are poised to take control of the House. Conversely, if Alvarado wins by a wide margin, it could indicate that neither party will have a significant majority. Florida is another state with several districts worth monitoring early in the night, particularly its 25th district where Democrat Jared Moskowitz is seeking re-election. The district was redrawn to favor Trump by 9 points but Moskowitz's win would signal a strong Democratic wave. The outcome of Florida's 25th and Kentucky's 6th districts could potentially determine which party ends up with control of the House, as these early results may give insight into the broader trend of the election. articles.title: David Lynch Establishes Daily Routines to Maintain Productivity
articles.summary: The director of cult classics Twin Peaks and Mulholland Drive has spoken about the importance of establishing daily routines in maintaining productivity.
articles.content: David Lynch's filmography is a testament to his ability to tap into the darker corners of the human experience, but surprisingly, his personal life is marked by a sense of predictability. The director of cult classics like Twin Peaks and Mulholland Drive has spoken about the importance of establishing daily routines in maintaining productivity. For Lynch, having a set schedule allows him to focus on more complex tasks, freeing up mental resources for creative pursuits. To maintain this balance, Lynch adheres to a strict morning routine that sets the tone for his day. He reportedly starts with a series of simple activities designed to stimulate his mind and body. The foundation of his daily structure is built around the concept of establishing habit patterns, which he believes enables him to channel mental energy towards creative endeavors. By allocating specific tasks to specific times of the day, Lynch creates an environment conducive to idea generation and work completion. One of the most notable aspects of Lynch's routine is its emphasis on discipline and consistency. By following a set schedule, he manages to maintain a sense of control over his daily life, allowing him to tackle complex projects with greater ease. The benefits of this approach are evident in Lynch's prolific output, which showcases his unique ability to navigate the realms of reality and fantasy. David Lynch's daily routine is built on a foundation of consistency, and one of the key components that sets his day in motion is coffee. As he often mentions, starting his day with a cappuccino is essential to getting him going, and it's a habit he shares with his iconic character Dale Cooper from Twin Peaks. In an interview with Vice in 2020, Lynch revealed that he relies on coffee throughout the day, joking that he has a constant drip of caffeine flowing into his system. This daily infusion of energy allows him to tackle his busy schedule with ease and focus. A crucial part of Lynch's daily routine is meditation, which he has practiced for over five decades. He began studying Transcendental Meditation in 1973 and continued the practice until his passing in 2025, never missing a session during that time. The technique involves sitting twice a day for 20 minutes to mentally recite a secret mantra provided by a certified teacher. The meditation practice is an integral part of Lynch's daily life, providing him with mental clarity and focus. He has credited the discipline with helping him navigate his creative work, allowing him to effortlessly transition between reality and fantasy in his projects. As Lynch settles into his morning routine, he is already mentally preparing for a day filled with creativity and productivity. With coffee coursing through his veins and his mind clear from meditation, he is well-equipped to tackle the challenges that lie ahead. David Lynch's commitment to Transcendental Meditation is a testament to its importance in his life. He practiced this technique daily from 1973 until his death in 2025, never missing a session, and credited it with maintaining his mental clarity and focus. The practice of Transcendental Meditation involves sitting for 20 minutes twice a day, mentally reciting a mantra provided by a certified teacher during an official course. This mantra is kept secret throughout one's life and serves as the focal point for meditation. The technique is designed to help individuals achieve a state of inner peace and calm. David Lynch was a strong advocate for Transcendental Meditation, highlighting its role in his happiness and creativity. articles.title: New Phone Battery Life Remains Steady Despite Advances
articles.summary: Our testing of 2026 models showed that they averaged about the same battery life as those from 2025 and 2024.
articles.content: The results of our latest battery life test have revealed a surprising trend: even the newest phones may not offer significantly longer battery life than their predecessors. Our testing of 2026 models showed that they averaged about the same battery life as those from 2025 and 2024, with some notable exceptions. Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max stood out as top performers in our tests, while foldable phones like the Motorola Razr (2026) and Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 also impressed. These devices feature silicon-carbon batteries that offer increased capacity without requiring larger physical batteries. This technology is a key factor in their improved performance. It's worth noting that even among the newest releases, some models still lag behind in terms of battery life. The latest iPhone Duo tied for top spot in one of our tests, indicating that Apple's efforts to improve battery life are paying off. However, it's not just the high-end devices that are delivering impressive results, late-2025 models like the iPhone 17 and OnePlus 15 also offer good value for those looking to extend their time between charges. Factors such as phone age and usage patterns can significantly impact battery life. A two- or three-year-old phone may experience reduced capacity, while frequent users will naturally drain their batteries more quickly. The relationship between a smartphone's battery capacity and its actual battery life is more complex than it seems. While manufacturers often tout larger batteries as a key feature of new devices, these bigger batteries are frequently offset by power-hungry features such as brighter screens, faster processors, and AI tools. Our testing of 28 phones in 2026 has consistently shown that a higher capacity battery doesn't necessarily translate to longer battery life throughout the day. This is borne out by our results, which include data from four handsets that didn't receive updates this year. To determine which phone had the longest-lasting battery, we put each device through two rigorous tests: a 3-hour streaming video test and a 45-minute anecdotal stress test. Both tests were conducted with the battery at full capacity, and the results show the remaining battery percentage after each test. The sheer number of phones tested is staggering - 32 devices, each subjected to our testing regimen for an impressive total of 120 hours over the past year. This extensive testing has allowed us to compare the battery life of a wide range of handsets, providing valuable insights into what makes some phones last longer than others. The iPhone 18 Pro Max emerged as the clear winner in our testing, thanks to its larger battery and iOS 27 optimizations, which work in tandem with Apple's efficient A20 Pro chip to deliver impressive battery life. Most smartphones sold in 2026 faced a price hike due to increased tariffs and higher component costs driven by demand from AI data centers. However, consumers can still find affordable options that deliver great battery life without breaking the bank. Two budget-friendly handsets from Motorola have emerged as top contenders in our testing - the $500 Moto G Stylus (2026) and the $600 Edge (2026). Despite lacking silicon-carbon batteries found in some of their Razr line, these phones surprisingly rank high in terms of battery life. It seems that their screens and processors are more power-efficient than those on pricier flagship models. For those seeking an affordable iOS option, Apple's lowest-priced phone is the $699 iPhone 17E. While it lasted a long time in our tests, its performance was on par with some high-end phones like the Motorola Razr Ultra (2026) and the Apple iPhone Duo, both of which are foldable devices priced at over $1,000. The testing process involved evaluating various handsets from well-known brands such as Samsung, Google, and Apple, alongside lesser-known models including Xiaomi's Leica Leitzphone, a photography-centric device that impressed with its camera capabilities. Another notable mention is the Trump Mobile T1 Phone, a rebranded 2024 HTC U24 Pro nicknamed the "Trump Phone" that struggled to rank high in our testing. The range of devices tested spanned multiple price points and features, allowing us to identify which phones deliver exceptional battery life without sacrificing performance or quality. The test involved simulating real-world usage scenarios to assess each phone's battery performance. Two tests were conducted: a 45-minute stress test and a 3-hour video streaming test. The stress test included activities such as video streaming, making video calls, playing games, and scrolling through social media. In the stress test, the iPhone 18 Pro Max and iPhone Duo emerged as top performers, losing only 1% of their battery life during the 45-minute period. Google's Pixel 11 Pro XL also impressed by tying for third place with a loss of just 3%. In contrast, the 2025 Pixel 10 Pro XL dropped by 7%. The 3-hour video streaming test saw the smaller iPhone 18 Pro take the top spot, losing only 6% of its battery life. The iPhone 17 and Motorola Razr (2026) flip phones both demonstrated impressive performance in this test. In addition to individual model results, we also analyzed how different brands performed overall by averaging their scores. This revealed that Apple's models consistently delivered strong battery life across the board. Only a few manufacturers had multiple models tested, so we were able to average the results for these companies. The data suggests that phones from Apple tend to have better battery life on average compared to other brands. The results of our extensive testing have shown that Apple's iPhones continue to outperform other brands in terms of battery life for the second year running. This trend is particularly evident when compared to other high-end smartphones on the market. OnePlus, a subsidiary of Oppo, has managed to secure the second spot, but it has announced plans to discontinue its US operations after releasing the OnePlus 15 series. As a result, those looking for an affordable phone with excellent battery life may want to consider purchasing either the OnePlus 15 or the budget-friendly OnePlus 15R. In recent years, several manufacturers, including Motorola and Samsung, have started incorporating silicon-carbon batteries into some of their models, particularly in foldable phones. This technology is expected to become more widespread among smartphone makers as early as 2027. For those who are satisfied with their current phone but concerned about its battery life, replacing the existing battery may be a viable solution rather than purchasing an entirely new device. Apple's official stores offer battery replacement services for iPhone owners, with prices ranging from $80 to $100 depending on the model and the extent of degradation. With Black Friday around the corner, consumers can look forward to discounts on portable power solutions. One product that has caught attention is a power bank tailored for the Apple iPhone Duo foldable, offering an affordable way to boost battery life. This power bank is designed specifically for the unique needs of the iPhone Duo's larger screen and dual charging capabilities, providing a convenient option for users who want to extend their device's battery life without breaking the bank. articles.title: US Bank Phishing Scam Exposed by KELA Researchers
articles.summary: KELA researchers have uncovered an extensive network of fraudulent websites designed to evade detection.
articles.content: A sophisticated banking scam has been exposed by KELA researchers, who have uncovered an extensive network of fraudulent websites designed to evade detection. These sites are capable of mimicking their own suspensions in order to remain online and continue their malicious activities. The infrastructure behind the scam hosts hundreds of fake websites that clone the official domains of major US banks and financial services. The "Suspended operation has been linked to 248 such domains, with many using a specific format, [keyword]-[bank].com, where keywords like secure," "disable," and "protect are inserted in place of legitimate words. The scam's focus is on business banking, suggesting that it targets companies rather than individual consumers. This could be due to the fact that businesses often have larger financial transactions and may be more vulnerable to phishing attacks. The infrastructure behind the scam appears to be run by a handful of servers hosted across two shared hosting providers, with ties to phishing campaigns targeting cryptocurrency exchanges and government services in various countries including the UK, Netherlands, Australia, and New Zealand. The cybercriminals behind this phishing campaign have devised an innovative tactic to evade detection: issuing takedown notices themselves. This unusual move appears to be a deliberate attempt to avoid being flagged and taken down by law enforcement agencies or technology firms. When a website is shut down due to malicious activity, visitors typically see a notice indicating that the domain has been suspended or taken offline. However, in this case, the scam artists have created their own fake suspension notices, effectively taking control of the narrative. This clever ploy allows them to masquerade as legitimate authorities, further deceiving unsuspecting victims. The fake account suspended" page is designed to look deceptively simple and innocuous at first glance. However, upon closer inspection, it's clear that this page is actually a phishing kit in disguise. The kit registers the IP address of each visitor on their second visit, providing valuable intelligence for the scammers. This sophisticated ruse also includes a challenge page similar to those used by Cloudflare, further confusing and misleading security teams and scanners who may be monitoring the domain. By employing this tactic, the cybercriminals are able to stay one step ahead of their pursuers, at least for now. The cybercriminals' tactics have taken a creative turn as they employ decoy measures to evade detection. These include fake suspension notices, blank pages, and redirections to Google, which are designed to deceive both scanners and cybersecurity teams. Some of these decoys even feature reCAPTCHAs, adding an extra layer of complexity for researchers trying to analyze the malicious domain. Furthermore, scripts have been detected that block browser developer tools, likely intended to slow down the analysis process and hinder investigators' efforts. The purpose behind displaying fake suspension notices is to create a false sense of security among scanners and cybersecurity teams. By making it appear as though someone else has already dealt with the malicious domain, the cybercriminals aim to divert attention away from their own activities. As a result, victims continue to see the cloned website, complete with enticing lures designed to trick them into entering sensitive information, ultimately leading to financial fraud and potential identity theft. This tactic allows the attackers to stay under the radar, at least for now. The phishing campaign remains active despite researchers disclosing their findings to law enforcement, with over 300 scam domains hosted on the same infrastructure since May this year. In addition to these, there are currently 248 live domains in operation, and new ones continue to emerge every day. One potential lead in uncovering the identity of the operator has been identified: a remote desktop connection was detected from a standard UK home broadband connection to the malicious infrastructure, but it remains unverified at this time. This lack of confirmation highlights the challenges faced by researchers in tracking down the individuals behind such complex scams. To protect oneself from these phishing attempts, users can employ various tools and strategies, including using a phishing link checker to verify the trustworthiness of URLs, as well as being cautious when receiving emails or messages claiming to be from their bank. articles.title: Bambu Lab Launches H3C Flagship 3D Printer
articles.summary: The Bambu Lab H3C flagship printer features nine separate nozzles that can handle different colors, types, and sizes of filaments simultaneously.
articles.content: A new behemoth in the world of 3D printing has emerged with the launch of Bambu Lab's H3C flagship printer. This massive machine boasts an impressive feature: nine separate nozzles that can handle different colors, types, and sizes of filaments simultaneously. The possibilities for creative expression are vast with this advanced technology. By allowing users to mix and match different materials, the H3C expands the boundaries of what is possible in 3D printing. This innovative approach enables artists, designers, and manufacturers to produce complex models with unprecedented precision and detail. Measuring over six feet tall, the H3C is not a machine for small spaces or workbenches. Its height made it difficult to load filament into the printer, even for someone of average height. However, Bambu Lab has provided a solution in the form of a metal rolling cart that can be purchased separately to lower the machine to a more manageable height. The H3C's price tag starts at $2,500 and includes the nine-filament system as well as an Automated Material System. A review of this printer is currently underway, with initial impressions suggesting a wealth of creative possibilities, but a full assessment will be reserved for later in this article. The setup process for this behemoth printer was surprisingly straightforward despite its complex design. Having a second person assist would be beneficial, as the various components need to be carefully connected and plugged in. This might seem daunting at first, but it's not overly complicated. The AMS 3 module atop the machine is an integral part of the H3C system, rather than a separate add-on. It plays a crucial role in its operation, setting it apart from other top-of-the-line printers on the market. The seamless integration of this component contributes to the overall sophistication of the printer's design. The H3C boasts cutting-edge hardware features that clearly establish it as a flagship model. Its heatbed can reach an impressive 120C, and the optional bird's-eye camera offers a unique perspective on print progress. Additionally, its top toolhead speed of 1,400 mm/s is noteworthy, although not directly indicative of print speeds. While high-speed performance has its advantages, it also brings potential drawbacks. Several prints have been marred by failures due to accidental touches or vibrations, particularly when printing at maximum speed. These issues often occurred on tall prints with supports or purge towers that were knocked off course. These setbacks predominantly arose from pushing the printer beyond recommended speeds, specifically at 125% of standard settings. In comparison, other printers handle such demands without issue. Bambu's new flagship printer boasts a unique nine-nozzle system called Swaptek, which employs conductive heating to achieve its goals. This setup is noteworthy because it shares similarities with another nine-nozzle system, INDX, but has some key differences in terms of functionality. A closer look at the technical specifications reveals that Swaptek outperforms INDX in one area: startup time. The nozzles can heat up rapidly due to data and power being supplied directly to each tool, allowing for a significant reduction in heating time - approximately six seconds per nozzle. While testing has shown that there isn't a substantial difference in speed between the H3C and Prusa Core One + INDX printers, the Core One does have an advantage when it comes to waste management. The printer's design avoids using a purge tower, resulting in less material being wasted compared to Bambu's Swaptek system. One of the key challenges associated with 3D printing TPU - a soft, rubbery material commonly used for creating flexible items like shoes and bouncy objects - is its tendency to clog AMS feeders. To address this issue, Bambu has developed toolheads capable of handling materials with different diameters, including those as small as 2.85mm. These new toolheads enable the creation of TPU that's more flexible after melting but easier to feed through the AMS. The result is a material that strikes a balance between flexibility and usability, allowing for the production of items that require a high degree of elasticity without sacrificing print quality or efficiency. The versatility of Bambu Lab's AMS is evident in its ability to print a wide range of materials, from warm and dry substances to more shelf-stable ones. This flexibility is made possible by two material slots with active heating chambers that can be used simultaneously. The machine's performance is impressive, particularly given its high price point. The nine separate nozzles enable rapid color changes, making it ideal for complex projects. Watching the H3C in action is a treat, as it quickly switches between nozzles to achieve seamless results. Some prints did encounter issues, but the AMS proved adept at detecting errors and pausing the print process accordingly. In one instance, I chose to continue printing despite a failed tower, resulting in a slightly damaged but still usable outcome. The machine's ability to handle various materials has opened up new possibilities for users. For example, I was able to 3D print my scanned head at life size, using silver to accurately capture the grey tones of my beard, the result was remarkably detailed and visually appealing. The test print produced by the Bambu Lab H2C was significantly better than the one from the CNET evaluation, showcasing its impressive capabilities. Every aspect of the print was maximized, resulting in a highly detailed and visually appealing outcome. The H3C is designed for users who have already pushed the limits of their current 3D printing machines, such as the P2S and A1 combos. It's not necessarily challenging to operate, but rather it requires an advanced level of expertise to fully utilize its capabilities. One notable feature of the H3C is its ability to produce complex models with ease, thanks to a range of options available right out of the box. This makes it an ideal choice for users who are looking to take their 3D printing skills to the next level. The Bambu Lab H2C and other high-end printers like the Swaptek, INDX, and multi-toolhead machines have established themselves as industry leaders in terms of performance and capabilities. These devices come in various sizes and price points, catering to different user needs and budgets. The future of 3D printing is undoubtedly exciting, with continuous innovation driving advancements in technology and capabilities. The Bambu Lab H2C represents a significant milestone in this evolution, pushing the boundaries of what is possible with 3D printing. articles.content: Chris Rock is set to direct his fourth feature film, Misty Green, a movie that explores the highs and lows of Hollywood through the eyes of its protagonist, an actress struggling to navigate her own demons. At its core, Misty Green is about talent and its limitations, as embodied by its lead character, played by Rosalind Eleazar. Misty Green is not an isolated project in Rock's oeuvre; it's part of a growing trend in his work, including his previous film, Top Five, which examined the highs and lows of show business. articles.title: RedMagic 12 Pro Launched Globally With Flagship Features
articles.summary: The RedMagic 12 Pro is a high-performance Android phone designed for gaming enthusiasts, featuring a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 CPU and proprietary RedMagic R5 Gaming Chipset.
articles.content: RedMagic has launched its latest flagship phone globally after initially releasing it in China. The company typically takes a gradual approach to international launches but opted for an earlier release for the RedMagic 12 Pro due to its strong performance capabilities. The new device is designed with gaming enthusiasts in mind, building on RedMagic's reputation for delivering high-performance mobile gaming experiences. At its core lies a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 CPU that can reach speeds of up to 5.01 GHz, paired with the proprietary RedMagic R5 Gaming Chipset. This powerful combination sets it apart from other Android devices, making it one of the fastest on the market. To put this performance into perspective, I compared the RedMagic 12 Pro's benchmark scores with those of my Pixel 9 Pro using Geekbench 7. The results showed that while the iPhone 18 Pro Max outperformed the RedMagic 12 Pro in single-core tests, the Android device excelled in multi-core benchmarks. In fact, the RedMagic 7 Pro demonstrated nearly double the multi-core score of the Pixel 11 Pro during testing. A benchmark score this high is unprecedented for an Android phone, making it clear that the RedMagic 12 Pro has set a new standard for mobile gaming performance. The RedMagic 12 Pro's performance is not limited to its benchmark scores, as it also shines in real-world usage. The phone responds promptly and navigates smoothly, making it feel like a high-end device. This seamless experience is due in part to the phone's sleek interface, which combines elements of Android and iOS. RedMagic's custom skin for Android has always been a standout feature for me, offering a unique blend of animation styles that rivals those found on Apple devices. By achieving this level of fluidity, RedMagic is effectively addressing one of Google's long-standing goals: creating the most refined user experience possible on Android. The phone's design and hardware also contribute to its exceptional performance. The interface glides smoothly when interacting with notifications or launching apps, while switching between applications results in zero lag or stuttering. Additionally, the device boasts a nearly edge-to-edge display, minimizing bezel and providing an immersive viewing experience. The RedMagic 12 Pro's design is also notable for its minimalistic approach to front-facing camera placement. Unlike many Android devices, it does not feature a pinhole or island-style camera arrangement, instead opting for a seamless display with no interruptions. This clean aesthetic adds to the overall premium feel of the device. The design of the RedMagic 12 Pro is one aspect where the device truly stands out. The glass back and front give it a premium feel in hand, making it a pleasure to hold. While glass can be prone to fingerprints, the smooth texture of the phone's surface helps mitigate this issue. The back also features integrated RGB lighting zones, which are customizable for various functions such as fan control or media atmosphere. Customization options extend beyond just lighting settings. Users can also personalize the device's behavior based on specific events like incoming calls, charging cycles, and alarm clock notifications. The inclusion of AI capabilities in the RedMagic 12 Pro adds another layer of functionality to the phone. This feature enables users to interact with various apps and features, including call assistance, live translation, and a notepad function. The Notepad app, in particular, showcased the device's impressive processing speed when used for tasks such as writing text about the RedMagic 12 Pro itself. The overall performance of the phone is remarkably fast, making it an excellent choice for gaming enthusiasts. The Red Magic 12 Pro comes preloaded with a selection of casual games that may not be to everyone's taste. Apps like Puzzle Spark, Mahjong Blast, and Little Kitty, Big City are included as part of the phone's standard package. While these titles might seem appealing to some users, they don't exactly scream high-end gaming experience. In fact, many of these preinstalled games sound more suitable for a mid-range device rather than a top-of-the-line flagship like the Red Magic 12 Pro. It's understandable that users can simply delete these apps if they're not interested in playing them, but their presence still detracts from the phone's overall premium feel. The inclusion of such casual games raises questions about the phone's target audience and its intended use case. Given the device's exceptional performance and capabilities, it would be more fitting for RedMagic to ship with a more curated selection of high-end gaming titles. Ultimately, the Red Magic 12 Pro stands out as one of the best Android flagships available today, boasting impressive speeds and performance that are unmatched by many other devices on the market. Since 2008, King has been at the helm of the Magic Wall during midterm and presidential elections, working tirelessly to bring viewers up-to-date information on voting trends. The 2020 presidential election was particularly grueling for King, with results taking about a week to tabulate. He worked back-to-back 12- to 16-hour days to ensure that CNN's coverage was comprehensive and accurate. To prepare for the midterms, King has been traveling extensively between battleground states, conducting interviews to stay on top of the national mood. His schedule is incredibly demanding, with an average of two weeks a month spent on the road during the midterm cycle. The last week before the election is particularly grueling, with five states visited in just five days. King's team typically focuses on one state at a time, spending several days there to gather information and conduct interviews. However, this year's schedule has been compressed, leaving little room for error or downtime. Despite his busy schedule, King makes it a point to stay active, often hitting the gym even when he gets little sleep. He also keeps a mental map of healthy restaurants in each state, ensuring that he can fuel up with nutritious food on the go. King's dedication to his work is impressive, especially considering that he lives with multiple sclerosis, a chronic condition that requires careful management. The unpredictable nature of a journalist's schedule can make it challenging to maintain a healthy diet, especially when traveling long distances between election coverage sites. articles.title: US House and Senate Control May Not Be Clear After Election Night
articles.summary: Election experts warn against premature claims of foul play or voter fraud as closely contested races make it challenging to declare a winner swiftly.
articles.content: Control of the US House and Senate may not be clear immediately after polls close on election night due to the closeness of key races. Election experts warn against premature claims of foul play or voter fraud as ballots are being cast and counted, urging voters to wait for evidence before jumping to conclusions. This caution comes as many critical contests will indeed be extremely close, making it challenging to declare a winner swiftly. David Becker, executive director and founder of the Center for Election Innovation & Research, expresses uncertainty about whether Americans will know who controls Congress on election night. The margin of victory plays a significant role in determining when election winners are projected by news outlets. This is because the outcome becomes more predictable as the gap between candidates widens. However, in closely contested races, the uncertainty persists even after polls close. California's size and voting system make it a prime example of how some key races may not be decided on election night. The state has both races that are likely to be called quickly due to large margins and others where the outcome could take days or weeks to determine. This is partly because mail ballots, which can be received up to a week after Election Day if postmarked on time, take longer to count. Mail ballots must undergo signature verification before being counted, a process that slows down the counting of votes in closely watched primaries. It's not uncommon for it to take several days to finalize the outcome of such races, as was seen in recent primary elections. This delay is due to the processing and verification of mail ballots received before Election Day. Mail ballots received on Election Day or later are subject to a slower counting process due to the signature verification procedure that must be completed before they can be counted. This delay is particularly relevant in counties where elections are typically very close, making every vote crucial in determining the outcome. In such cases, even a slight delay in counting mail ballots can significantly impact the final result. The scrutiny that these counties face is often amplified by intense media attention and public interest in the election's outcome. Gates, who has personal experience with high-stakes elections, notes that Arizona's Maricopa County has been under close examination since 2020 when Joe Biden became the first Democrat to win the state since Bill Clinton. Arizona's Maricopa County has been under scrutiny for some time now, having been at the center of attention since 2020 when Joe Biden became the first Democrat to win the state in nearly three decades. The complexity of ballots and mail voting is a significant factor contributing to delayed vote counting. In Pennsylvania and Wisconsin, election officials are not allowed to process mail ballots until Election Day morning, which further slows down the counting process. In addition to these factors, the varying composition of votes from different methods, such as mail-in, early in-person, and Election Day votes, can lead to shifting numbers throughout the night and days following the initial count. The outcome of some key elections may not be clear on election night due to varying voting methods and their impact on vote counting. Mail-in ballots, which have been criticized by President Trump as "mail-in cheating, didn't start favoring Democrats until 2020 when the pandemic led to a surge in mail voting. This shift in voting patterns has resulted in a phenomenon known as the red mirage effect, where early results of in-person voting may initially show a Republican leading. This blue wave" effect is particularly evident in states where election officials cannot begin processing mail ballots until Election Day, such as Pennsylvania in 2020. In these cases, late-arriving mail-in votes can significantly impact the outcome of an election, causing it to swing in favor of the Democrat. The processing of mail-in votes has a significant impact on election results, particularly in close contests where every vote counts. According to Becker, Election Day votes are typically counted first, followed by the processing of mail-in ballots. Mail-in votes can swing an election in favor of the Democrat if they arrive late, but it is unclear whether this will be the case in these key races. If candidates complain about the process, it may indicate that they think they have lost, Becker noted, adding a humorous observation to the discussion. articles.title: Fires in the US Are Increasingly Destructive Due to Climate Change and Human Development
articles.summary: A new study warns that if left unchecked, the risk of fire damage to buildings will nearly triple by 2060, particularly in areas with high poverty and housing burdens.
articles.content: Fires in the United States are becoming increasingly destructive, fueled by climate change and exacerbated by human development and settlement patterns. The trend is alarming: fires are growing faster, larger, and more intense, while people continue to build homes and communities in areas prone to wildfires. New research from the University of Colorado Boulder's Cooperative Institute for Research in Environmental Sciences (CIRES) warns that if left unchecked, the risk of fire damage to buildings will nearly triple by 2060. The study highlights a pressing concern: many of the regions most vulnerable to wildfires are also home to significant poverty and housing burdens. In the western United States, areas with high projected fire risk overlap with existing socioeconomic disparities, creating a perfect storm of vulnerability. "This is a call for action," said Virginia Iglesias, CIRES Earth Lab director and lead author of the paper, emphasizing the urgent need for proactive measures to mitigate and prepare for wildfires. Historical data on burned areas and development patterns has been used to reconstruct fire risk to structures in the United States from 1945 to 2023. This information was combined with weather, climate, and housing-density data to create a model that forecasts the risk to buildings through 2060. Under current projections, moderate climate change mitigation and no new fire adaptations will lead to a significant increase in structural losses from fires. The team's estimates suggest that up to 449,100 buildings could be destroyed or damaged by 2060, representing nearly triple the number of losses seen previously. The researchers emphasize the importance of considering both current development patterns and past decisions when planning for future fire risks. This includes thinking about where new developments should take place, as well as addressing existing vulnerabilities in communities that are at high risk from fires. Regional differences in fire risk have also emerged from the study, with the western United States set to bear the brunt of structural losses due to wildfires. However, the central U.S. is expected to experience the largest increase in fire risk, driven by rising fire activity in grasslands and prairies, while the eastern U.S. will see smaller but still significant increases in risk despite its lower overall exposure. Fires can occur anywhere in the country, regardless of location, as they don't discriminate based on geography. However, some regions have been relatively spared from destructive fires, which has left them less prepared for such events. The team's projections indicate that by 2051-2060, communities with socio-economic vulnerabilities will bear the brunt of increased fire risks across the US. In particular, census tracts in the western states are expected to experience significant rises in risk, with a notable proportion experiencing poverty and housing burdens. In an effort to mitigate this growing threat, Colorado introduced a new wildfire resiliency code in July 2025, aimed at reducing the risk of fires affecting life and property. While code changes are a step in the right direction, they alone may not be enough to address the issue. The researchers emphasize that addressing fire risks must take into account social vulnerability factors, including community resources and capacity for recovery. By considering these aspects alongside geographical location, policymakers can develop more effective strategies for mitigating the impact of fires on vulnerable communities. A crucial aspect of addressing fire losses to U.S. buildings is investing in targeted mitigation strategies. Iglesias emphasizes that effective action requires investment, and the results of this research can help policymakers prioritize their efforts by identifying areas where policies and building codes will have the greatest impact. By considering geographical location alongside these factors, policymakers can develop more tailored approaches to reducing fire risks in vulnerable communities. This is essential for minimizing the devastating consequences of fires on buildings and the people who live or work in them. Ultimately, proactive measures are necessary to mitigate the predicted near-tripling of fire losses by 2060 without new protections being put in place. articles.title: Chinese and American AI Models Show Significant Gap
articles.summary: A new ranking system has revealed a significant gap between Chinese and American AI models, sparking fresh concerns about the perceived threat from cheaper, freely available AI technology.
articles.content: A new ranking system has revealed a significant gap between Chinese and American AI models, sparking fresh concerns about the perceived threat from cheaper, freely available AI technology. Artificial Analysis, a well-respected independent firm, has revamped its testing methodology to better reflect real-world usage patterns. This overhaul includes keeping many of the tests confidential, thereby preventing AI companies from training their models specifically to excel on these hidden challenges. The results are telling: under the new system, China's top open-weight AI models have fallen 9 points behind the overall leader, a significant increase from the 3-point gap seen previously. The shift in testing methodology has led to a significant increase in the gap between open-weight and proprietary AI models. This change has resulted in China's top open-weight AI models falling 9 points behind the overall leader, as previously reported. However, this new development suggests that American companies may have had an even greater advantage all along. The results indicate that their models perform better not only in specific tasks but also in more complex scientific challenges. This is evident from the performance of a smaller Anthropic model, which outperformed every AI model with publicly released weights. Experts like Sridhar Ramaswamy, CEO of Snowflake and a former Google executive, have highlighted the significance of this change. According to him, when AI companies know exactly how their technology will be tested, they can train it to excel at those particular tasks. This has made it harder for hackers to exploit vulnerabilities in proprietary models. The implications of these findings are far-reaching, potentially strengthening the investment case for Anthropic's planned IPO and a possible future OpenAI listing. Proponents of open-weight models have acknowledged that something may have been awry with their approach, but the full extent of this shift remains to be seen. The previous index used to measure AI models may have been overly generous in its assessment of open-weight models, according to Nathan Lambert, cofounder of Trillium Labs. Lambert's observation is significant because it suggests that the threat posed by Chinese AI models may not be as substantial as initially thought. This notion is further supported by data from OpenRouter, a service that allows developers to access AI models from various providers. Dax Raad, cofounder of OpenCode, analyzed traffic through OpenRouter and found that almost all the previous day's DeepSeek traffic could be handled by a single rack of high-performance Nvidia computers. This would require an investment of around $6 million to $7 million. This relatively modest amount of computing power is striking given the immense attention Chinese AI models have garnered in recent times. However, it's essential to note that OpenRouter only represents a portion of the market, and its figures may not accurately reflect demand for open-weight models across the industry. More than 1 billion people use ChatGPT every month, a staggering figure that highlights the vast scale of OpenAI's user base. However, this massive usage does not necessarily translate to demand for open-weight AI models. In fact, users may be interacting with OpenAI's closed AI models more frequently than previously thought. The contrast between usage figures and market rankings raises questions about the perceived threat posed by Chinese AI companies. While some argue that these firms are rapidly closing the gap with American leaders, the data suggests otherwise. Open-weight models remain competitive in specific areas such as software development, offering businesses greater control and potentially lower costs. Despite this, the narrative of a Chinese threat to OpenAI and Anthropic has shaped industry expectations and investor valuations. However, the evidence presented challenges this notion, underscoring the importance of distinguishing between hype and reality when assessing demand for open-weight AI models. articles.title: Exit Polls Offer Early Indication of Voter Sentiment
articles.summary: Exit polls capture the views of voters as they leave their polling stations, providing an early indication of voter sentiment and motivations.
articles.content: Exit polls offer a glimpse into voting behavior before election night tallies are finalized. These surveys capture the views of voters as they leave their polling stations, providing an early indication of voter sentiment and motivations. Unlike public opinion polls that predict voting intentions, exit polls gather data from actual voters on Election Day itself. This includes voters who cast ballots early or by mail, with efforts made to reach them through phone calls, mail, and online interactions as well. The companies involved in conducting the exit poll for this year's midterm election include SSRS, a survey and market research firm, working on behalf of several major news organizations. These partner organizations receive the same data from the exit polls. Voters who participate in the national exit poll are asked whether they voted for the Democratic or Republican House candidate in their district. In addition to these basic voting questions, many states also ask which candidates voters supported in Senate and governor's races. The demographic data collected from respondents is crucial, as it helps illustrate how different groups of people voted and what mattered to them when making their decisions. This information is used to weight the exit poll, ensuring that it accurately reflects both the demographics of the electorate and the election results themselves. Interviewers will be stationed at over 450 polling locations in 15 Senate battleground states this year to conduct exit polls. Each interviewer must adhere to local rules regarding their location outside the polling station. This ensures that the poll is conducted fairly and without influencing voters. To capture a broad range of voters, the exit poll includes a pre-election survey. This survey allows voters who participate early, by mail, or on Election Day to be included in the results. The pre-election survey reaches respondents through various methods, including mailed invitations, telephone interviews, text messages, and online surveys. Before Election Day, respondents can choose to complete the pre-election survey in either English or Spanish. Afterward, interviewers follow up with respondents to confirm that they voted and who they ultimately supported. This step helps to ensure the accuracy of the exit poll results. On Election Day, interviewers count voters as they leave polling stations and randomly select individuals to participate in the exit poll. They offer questionnaires to every third person or every fifth person, for instance, from the time polls open until they close. Interviewers then phone in these results to a data center three times throughout the day. Voters who participate in exit polls can choose to fill out questionnaires anonymously by depositing them in boxes, just like their actual ballots. This ensures that their answers remain confidential and secret. The same anonymity applies to those who participate through mail, phone, or online interviews - no personal information is collected about the voters. Exit polls are conducted in a significant number of states this year. In addition to a national poll covering all 50 states, there will also be state-specific exit polls in 45 states where Senate and governor's contests have high stakes. These polls aim to capture the views of voters on various issues relevant to their specific state. The national exit poll sample will consist of over 75,000 voters who participate through different channels - voting locations, online interviews, and phone calls. In 15 states with more significant elections, interviewers will be stationed outside at least 30 randomly selected voting locations to gather data from a larger number of participants. The remaining states will use phone, online, and mail surveys. The sample size for each of the 15 states mentioned earlier will be approximately 4,000 voters. However, in Alaska, the sample size will be slightly smaller at about 3,000 voters, with an additional focus on early-voting locations before Election Day. The NBC News Decision Desk will use a combination of exit poll data to help project race outcomes on election night, while also providing real-time insight into voter motivations and sentiments. This year's exit polls will include between 500 and 3,000 voters in all states with Senate and governor's races, except for Alaska where the sample size will be slightly smaller at about 3,000 voters. The focus in Alaska will be on early-voting locations before Election Day. The data collected through these exit polls is essential to understanding voter behavior and informing election-night coverage.
